title: Brier-Score Trend
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=brier:score
| timechart span=1mon avg(brier) as avg_brier
| eventstats avg(avg_brier) as overall
description: Trends your Brier score — a measure of forecasting accuracy — over time so you can watch your judgement improve.
value: A falling Brier score is hard evidence that you are getting better at predicting your own life, not just guessing.
implementation: Ingest scored forecasts into `index=personal`; trend the monthly Brier score.
visualization: Line chart of monthly Brier score (lower is better).
grandmaExplanation: It tracks a score of how accurate your predictions are, so you can watch your judgement sharpen over time.
